exposure: hysteroscopic resection of retained products of conception
outcome: Abnormal placentation (placenta previa, placenta accreta, retained placenta)
cohort: Women who underwent hysteroscopic resection of RPOCs at Northwestern Prentice Women's Hospital between January 2004 and December 2014
finding: Women who undergo hysteroscopic resection of RPOCs have a higher rate of abnormal placentation in subsequent pregnancies compared to the general population.
